decisions.rationale: 6 days in, no project, no invite, no key milestone despite a held welcome call [calendar:0e89e127] and two outreach emails [email:1cb4930d, email:a3738623] with zero customer replies or tickets. Team plan and attended call suggest real intent, but total silence after onboarding touchpoints makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: Getting Clearwater Media's first project going
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. Since then I haven't wanted to crowd your inbox, but I'd like to make the next step easy.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Clearwater Media works. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you live, or answer anything by reply.

Best,
Nadia
